title: Someone collapses. 20 people walk past. Do THIS 🚨
caption:
The one sentence that gets a crowd to help 🚨
Save this. You might need it one day 👇
first_comment: Share this so more people know 🙏
sources: Darley J. M. & Latané B. (1968) 'Bystander intervention in emergencies: diffusion of responsibility', Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 8(4): 377-383

British Red Cross / American Red Cross first aid guidance: give specific people specific tasks (call emergency services, fetch a defibrillator); hands-only CPR, hard and fast in the centre of the chest
